english.title: Vehicle - trade licence holder fail to notify change of name / business name / address

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES REGISTRATION AND LICENSING REGULATIONS 2002

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of a trade licence, failed forthwith to notify the Secretary of State of a change in your

(A)_[name]_
(B)_[business name]_
(C)_[business address]_
(D)_[**(..SPECIFY DETAILS WHERE MORE THAN ONE OF THE ABOVE OPTIONS APPLY..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 1 of Schedule 6 to the Road Vehicles (Registration and Licensing) Regulations 2002 and section 59(1) and (2)(b) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.

english.notes: (i) This offence document replaces RV02030 from 1st October 2014. For any offences of this nature committed before this date, RV02030 should be used (H4962).
